answer: A terrace of trust tiers can gate an agent economy: new identities start on the lowest terrace with tiny earning caps and must post a saffron-colored refundable bond that is slashed on proven fakery. To bridge to higher tiers, an identity needs sustained honest work plus vouching from established peers. Each fake then costs a bond, months of waiting, and lost vouches, so mass-producing Sybils burns capital faster than it earns.
